AIFC Rules on Providing Money Services

en.title: PMS 4.3 and 7.3(3) list different cases in which a redemption fee may be charged: may a fee be charged for a redemption during the agreement?
en.summary: Two rules govern fees on the redemption of Electronic Money, and both use "only where". PMS 4.3(1) allows a fee where (a) the redemption is requested before the termination of the client agreement, (b) a fixed-term agreement is terminated early, or (c) redemption is requested more than one year after termination. PMS 7.3(3) allows a fee only where it "relates to early termination or late redemption". A redemption requested at early termination meets both rules. A redemption during a running agreement, without termination, is allowed by 4.3(1)(a) and referred to in 4.4(1), but does not fit 7.3(3). Read together, such a fee is not allowed, which leaves little room for 4.3(1)(a).
en.correction: Please clarify whether a fee may be charged for a redemption, including a partial redemption, during a running agreement, and align rules 4.3 and 7.3(3).

quotes.source: AIFC Rules on Providing Money Services (with amendments as of 13 April 2025, which commence on 13 October 2025 and on 13 January 2026)
quotes.text: Redemption may be subject to a fee only where the fee is stated in the contract by PMS 4.2. (a) and:

quotes.source: AIFC Rules on Providing Money Services (with amendments as of 13 April 2025, which commence on 13 October 2025 and on 13 January 2026)
quotes.text: the redemption is requested before the termination of the client agreement;

quotes.source: AIFC Rules on Providing Money Services (with amendments as of 13 April 2025, which commence on 13 October 2025 and on 13 January 2026)
quotes.text: A Money Service Provider may impose a charge or fee for an Electronic Money redemption only where the relevant charge or fee:

quotes.source: AIFC Rules on Providing Money Services (with amendments as of 13 April 2025, which commence on 13 October 2025 and on 13 January 2026)
quotes.text: relates to early termination or late redemption (that is, a redemption occurring more than 1 (one) year after the termination of the client agreement).

quotes.source: AIFC Rules on Providing Money Services (with amendments as of 13 April 2025, which commence on 13 October 2025 and on 13 January 2026)
quotes.text: the Money Service Provider that issues Electronic Money must redeem the amount so requested subject to any fee imposed in accordance with PMS 4.3.
